# Frozen baseline: mobile/lib/l10n/app_en.arb keys that interpolate a count but
# carry no ICU plural. Generated by scripts/check_countable_plural_floor.sh. The
# set may only SHRINK (growth fails CI vs origin/main).
#
# A flat countable key still renders the number; it just stops inflecting the
# noun, shipping "1 videos". Most entries below are intentionally PERMANENT —
# units, percentages, ordinals, ratios and counts detached from their noun must
# NEVER be pluralized. The trailing '# reason' says which. Issue: #3633.
analyticsDiagnosticsHydratedBulk # detached: colon form, dev diagnostic
analyticsDiagnosticsHydratedViews # detached: colon form, dev diagnostic
analyticsDiagnosticsMissingViews # detached: colon form, dev diagnostic
analyticsDiagnosticsTotalVideos # detached: colon form, dev diagnostic
analyticsDiagnosticsWithViews # detached: colon form, dev diagnostic
analyticsFollowersCount # detached: "Followers: {count}" — noun precedes the count
analyticsFollowingCount # detached: "Following: {count}" — noun precedes the count
authWaitingForConnection # unit: "{seconds}s" symbol
bugReportImagesCount # ratio: "{count} of {max}"
contentPreferencesDoneCount # detached: parenthetical "Done ({count} selected)"
deleteAccountProgressEvents # ratio: "{current} / {total}"
devOptionsClipRecoveryOrphanFiles # detached: colon form
exploreVideoCounter # ratio: "Video {current}/{total}"
inboxMessageRequestsSemanticLabel # detached: "{requestCount} pending" has no noun
libraryClipsSavePartialResult # detached: "{n} saved, {n} failed" has no noun
libraryCreateVideo # detached: parenthetical "Create Video ({count})"
libraryDraftCopyTitle # ordinal: "(copy {number})"
metadataMoreReposters # detached: "+{count} more" has no noun
peopleListsAddButtonWithCount # detached: "Add {count}" has no noun
profileBadgeMoreRecipients # detached: "+{count} more" has no noun
profileVideoThumbnailLabel # ordinal: position in a grid
relayDiagnosticConnectedRatio # ratio: "{connected}/{total}"
relayDiagnosticEndpointSummary # ratio: "{ok}/{total} OK"
rgbColorSemanticLabel # not a count: RGB channel values
settingsStorageBrokenClipsFound # detached: colon form
timeDaysAgo # unit: "{count}d" symbol
timeHoursAgo # unit: "{count}h" symbol
timeMinutesAgo # unit: "{count}m" symbol
timeShortDays # unit: "{count}d" symbol
timeShortHours # unit: "{count}h" symbol
timeShortMinutes # unit: "{count}m" symbol
timeShortMonths # unit: "{count}mo" symbol
timeShortWeeks # unit: "{count}w" symbol
timeShortYears # unit: "{count}y" symbol
videoClipSemanticValueSelectedAtPosition # ordinal: pick order
videoCollaboratorWithMore # detached: "+{count}" overflow badge
videoCollaboratorWithPendingSuffix # detached: parenthetical "({pending} pending)"
videoEditorClipVolumeLabel # ordinal: "Clip {index}"
videoEditorSaturationBrightnessValue # percentage
videoEditorSplitPositionInvalid # unit: "{minDurationMs}ms" symbol
videoEditorStopMotionFrameSemanticLabel # ordinal: "frame {position} of {total}"
videoEditorStopMotionTooShortSnackbar # unit: "{seconds}s" symbol
videoEditorTimelineClipSelectedSemanticLabel # ordinal: "Clip {index} of {total}"
videoEditorTimelineClipSemanticLabel # ordinal: "Clip {index} of {total}"
videoEditorTimelineClipUnselectedSemanticLabel # ordinal: "Clip {index} of {total}"
videoEditorTimelineDraggingClipSemanticLabel # ordinal: "Dragging clip {index}"
videoEditorTimelinePositionFormat # unit: "{minutes}m {seconds}s" symbols
videoEditorTimelineVolumePreview # percentage
videoEditorTransitionCurveOptionSemanticLabel # ordinal: "Easing curve {number}"
videoEditorVoiceOverTakeName # ordinal: "Recording {number}"
